claims: OpenClaw was formerly Clawdbot/Moltbot.
OpenClaw is an open-source autonomous AI agent.
OpenClaw is self-hosted.
OpenClaw is designed to execute tasks directly on a user's computer such as browsing the web, managing files, and controlling APIs.
OpenClaw operates via messaging apps like WhatsApp/Discord.
OpenClaw uses local Large Language Models (LLMs).
OpenClaw can read/write files.
OpenClaw can send emails.
OpenClaw can automate workflows by interpreting screenshots of the user interface.
OpenClaw was developed by Peter Steinberger.
OpenClaw began as Clawdbot.
OpenClaw became Moltbot.
OpenClaw was renamed OpenClaw due to trademark issues with Anthropic.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described OpenClaw as potentially the fastest-growing open-source project in history.
Cisco Blogs notes that OpenClaw presents significant security challenges because the agent has control over a user's machine and internet access.
NVIDIA Newsroom announced NemoClaw.
NemoClaw adds security controls.
NemoClaw integrates NVIDIA NeMo models into the OpenClaw framework.
OpenClaw is installed via terminal command.
OpenClaw requires configuration to connect with an LLM such as ChatGPT or Anthropic’s Claude.
Users interact with OpenClaw mainly through messengers like Telegram or WhatsApp.
OpenClaw can run locally on a user’s own machine.
OpenClaw can run on a server.
